about_the_game:
Run endlessly through your mental chaos — and summon your weirdest inner rot monsters along the way.

Dash through a surreal mental battlefield filled with literal manifestations of your deepest insecurities — imaginary perfect people, belittling gazes, spinning chair of unemployment, and house-shaped meteors crashing down with the weight of failed dreams.

Level up and summon absurd AI-generated monsters to help you run further. Each summon is a strange, pixel-born entity with a will of its own, turning your existential crisis into an army of weird helpers.

Behind the frantic dodging and jumping lies a roguelite upgrade system that evolves your runs: collect Coins and Likes, unlock new skills, and build synergies that make each attempt feel fresh — and chaotic.

Note: Some elements of this game — including early visual sketches and portions of gameplay scripting — were created with the assistance of AI tools, as part of the developer's effort to learn, experiment, and build with limited experience and resources.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd Gen) or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4th Gen) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GT 710 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: A chaotic 2D pixel endless runner where you dodge your insecurities and summon weird AI monsters to help you outrun failure, doubt, and existential dread. Simple to control, wild to survive, and full of existential satire.
